item: Pressure recorder: a machine that stays short is snapshotted, and the moment the memory guard engages
status: SHIPPED (draft PR, unmerged, browser-unverified: no UI)
summary: The 091717 instance sat 17 minutes at 44-60 MB available with the memory guard engaged and was killed; the recorder had witnesses for the slide and none for the plateau. session_hwm now snapshots every thread at the moment the guard engages (with its reason) and every 300 s while memory is below the line or the guard stays engaged, each snapshot saying whether the guard was engaged; the report names both reasons. Cost bounded and commented: 300 s, the existing stack caps, newest 8 kept, kernel counters and sys.getallocatedblocks only (never gc.get_objects). No gate change: the guard already reads available memory and engaged in that crash. Stopping cleanly when memory does not recover stays the user's question 22; a relaunch starts offline under R117. Lesson in LESSONS.md: A PLATEAU UNDER THE MEMORY LINE WAS UNRECORDED BY DESIGN.
